description: This file defines the HorizontalYAxisRenderer class, responsible for rendering the horizontal Y axis in chart types like Bar2D. It includes methods for initialization, layout calculations, drawing axis lines, tick marks, labels, and titles, as well as utility functions for axis scaling and tick mark positioning.

classes.name: HorizontalYAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing the horizontal Y axis in charts, extending YAxisRenderer to implement axis-specific rendering logic, including layout and visual representation.

methods.name: HorizontalYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with specified parameters.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer info based on the Y axis data, setting up scale, labels, and title information.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space needed for the axis, including tick labels, grid lines, and axis title.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the horizontal Y axis, including tick marks, labels, axis line, and title.

methods.name: InitScale
methods.description: Calculates axis scale parameters such as min, max, and tick intervals.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Determines the start and end positions of major and minor tick marks based on tick mark types.

methods.name: CalcYAxis
methods.description: Determines the minimum and maximum data values from chart series for axis scaling.
